findings.explanation: The detailed implementation is entirely boilerplate and lacks actionable guidance for NetApp FabricPool tiering metrics.
findings.quote: Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Splunk Add-on for NetApp Data ONTAP (`TA-netapp_ontap`) — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=netapp:ontap:vol into storage. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower.
findings.suggested_fix: Add specific steps for enabling FabricPool volume inventory inputs and verifying cloud tier storage metrics in Splunk.

summary: Marred by title salad fragments, self-referential value statements, formulaic false-positive templates, and generic detailed implementation boilerplate.
